# .NET Entity Framework Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > .NET

## Overview

Implements data access layers with Entity Framework Core including migrations, query optimization, and advanced mapping configurations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [dotnet-entity-framework-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
dotnet-entity-framework-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@dotnet-entity-framework-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design entity configurations with Fluent API
- Optimize queries with split queries and compiled queries
- Manage migrations with proper versioning strategy
- Implement value objects and owned types

## Technology Standards Applied

- **EF Core Documentation**: Official Entity Framework Core patterns
- **EF Core Performance**: Query optimization and tracking behavior
- **Migration Strategy**: Database migration best practices
